Amendment No. 1 sets Quarrendon Freight Lines at **185 seats**, effective 1 September 2025. It was signed 19 August 2025.

For the QBR deck, note that Amendment No. 3 (executed 22 September 2026) raises the count to **230 seats** effective 1 January 2027, so the account is at 185 today and goes to 230 next year.
